name: shopping_env
description: Read the next deterministic product OCR context for the active mapped category. This tool accepts no arguments: call with {} until sample_index equals sample_limit (5), then copy the returned dataset_category exactly, which may differ from the taxonomy node name.

dataset_category.description: Trusted dataset category to copy verbatim into the market document and every product entry; do not replace with taxonomy node name.

sample_index.description: One-based number of distinct products selected so far; keep calling with {} until this equals sample_limit.

sample_limit.description: Trusted required distinct-product count; final output must cover exactly this many products.
